remarks: Welcome to First Forestview. This spacious, walk to town, 3 bedroom, 2.5 baths have hardwood floors throughout. Eat in Kitchen, combined living room/ dining room with gas fireplace and slider to a bluestone patio. Primary with bath. Large room above the garage for storage, not a room per P&Z. Ample storage in basement with bulkhead access. Attached two car garage. Good credit a must, credit ck required. No pets. rule of HOA. 1st, and 2 months security at lease signing. 3 hr notice. Addendum to lease must be signed. Owner is agent.
